newsitem.title: USA: Bally Total nets $90 mln from offering.
newsitem.headline: Bally Total nets $90 mln from offering.

text.p: Bally Total Fitness Holding Corp said Tuesday it completed a public offering of eight million shares of its common stock and received proceeds of about $90 million.
An overallotment option of one million shares was exercised.
Bally Total Fitness operates 320 fitness centers in 27 states and Canada.
Proceeds from the offering will be used for capital expenditures, to develop new facilities and refurbish and upgrade existing facilities, to repay debt, and for working capital.
Shares of Bally Total Fitness were trading up 1/2 to 14-1/8.
